design: Reuse eight name pairs with three four-token and three five-token insertions plus base. Four new insertions chosen by token length before inference. Compare fixed-position content effects. Insert text strictly after selected name. Fixed heads, no case selection. Compute rotary-only predictions from base prompts before evaluating edited prompts.
scope: Physical edits change query context as well as distance. No claim of pure position manipulation. Coefficient interventions touch only the selected persistent-bus edge; other prompt-induced changes remain.
